feature.label: CB-SEM General SEM V3 ML Point Estimation

claim.supported_scope: Standard ordinary-ML point estimation for a newly created schema-6 general_sem_v1 project containing one promoted resident SemModelV4, raw continuous unweighted listwise data, and a single-group recursive common-factor SEM with at least one structural regression.
claim.estimand: The model-implied covariance-structure ML estimates, uncertainty rows, bounded fit indices, and provisional identification facts for the exact resident free and fixed parameter table.
assumptions: The structural graph is recursive and every observed indicator is continuous.
The resident parameter table contains only executable fixed values or free rows with compatible equality labels and finite open bounds.
The exact archive, dataset, model, recipe, compiler, and Registry cell identities remain unchanged through publication.
exclusions: CFA-only models, feedback, groups, weights, clusters, strata, matrix input, mean structures, categorical indicators, robust ML, WLSMV, FIML, composites, derived variables, and interactions are excluded.
Derived parameter rows, explicit constraint objects, derived effect requests, and conditional probes are represented but not executed.
warnings: Standard qualification uses the user-approved streamlined Version 2.50 integration profile and remains limited to the exact registered predicate.
The V2 ML kernel foundation does not by itself qualify this new resident-authority workflow or its broader parameter-table predicate.

equations.expression: F_ml = log|Sigma(theta)| + tr(S Sigma(theta)^-1) - log|S| - p

references.citation: Bollen (1989), Structural Equations with Latent Variables
Existing validation-only independent CB-SEM ML and lavaan reference implementations

simulations.design: Existing CB-SEM ML recovery sources are reused only as an engine foundation; Rank 3 recursive parameter-table qualification remains pending.
simulations.seed_policy: Scenario-indexed deterministic sources with failures retained.
simulations.acceptance_rule: The future Rank 3 evidence report must hash and pass the exact frozen sources; this manifest alone records no passing result.
